Nhap gia tri vao o filter chip 'Internal name' (vd 'ZEBRA'), quan sat ket qua + where-clause
Xoa filter, nhap gia tri vao o filter chip 'Internal tags' (vd 'beta'), quan sat ket qua + where-clause
Doi chieu voi Search chung cung tu khoa 'ZEBRA', quan sat ket qua khac biet (xem CHK-01-007)

Day la baseline hien tai (PO chi de nghi 'can explore ky hon', KHONG khang dinh truoc ket qua cu the nen KHONG duoc nang len CONFIRMED_EXPECTED du evidence ro rang) - lech khoi baseline nay can dieu tra, KHONG tu dong coi la fix hay regression.

Co che la browser history TU khoi phuc vi toan bo state nam trong query string (URL-sync cua CONF-001), KHONG phai logic back-restore rieng cua app. GIOI HAN PHAM VI: chi xac nhan cho /products qua duong Back trinh duyet that; phan mo rong sang /campaigns va /orders (theo resolution cua CONF-001) VAN CHUA duoc xac minh truc tiep trong lần khảo sát nay - KHONG duoc suy dien ap dung cho 2 trang do.
